figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT month,ROUND(moving_avg,2) AS avg3,ROUND(100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY month;

figures.title: 移动平均与环比：窗口一行一行往下滑

stages.label: ① 处理前：monthly（4 行，按月份排好）

tables.sql: SELECT month, sales FROM monthly ORDER BY month

stages.label: ② 每一行：取上月，并对“本月 + 前 2 个月”求平均
stages.via: LAG(sales) 取上一行；AVG(…) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW 取最近 3 行（不足就用现有的行）

tables.sql: SELECT month, sales, LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev, ROUND(AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS avg3 FROM monthly ORDER BY month

stages.label: ③ 处理后：取整并算环比
stages.via: 环比增长率 = （本月 − 上月）÷ 上月 × 100；第一个月没有上月，结果是 NULL

tables.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT month,ROUND(moving_avg,2) AS avg3,ROUND(100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY month;

figures.conclusion: 移动平均用“滑动的窗口”平滑波动；环比只和上一行比。
